churches.pastor: Pastor (UCC — verify current pastor on website)

score_notes.scripture: UCC rejects biblical inerrancy and embraces historical-critical hermeneutics. Scripture is treated as a human document reflecting evolving faith community, not the authoritative Word of God.
score_notes.gender: UCC fully affirms LGBTQ+ clergy, same-sex marriage, and was one of the first denominations to do so (1970s-1980s). 'Open and Affirming' is a standard UCC congregation designation.

churches.assessment: Grace Reformed Church is a historic Washington DC congregation with a fascinating history — it was the church of President Theodore Roosevelt during his time in the White House. Originally an Evangelical and Reformed Church congregation, it merged into the United Church of Christ (UCC) in 1957. Today the UCC is one of the most theologically liberal denominations in America, fully affirming LGBTQ+ clergy and same-sex marriage, rejecting biblical inerrancy, and embracing pluralistic soteriology. Individual UCC congregations vary in their degree of liberalism, but the denomination provides no orthodox accountability. The historic building and Roosevelt connection make it interesting from a historical standpoint, but for a man seeking biblically sound Word ministry and gospel-centered community, Grace Reformed DC is not recommended. Seek out Reformed churches in the area that have maintained confessional integrity.

churches.assessment: Second Baptist Church (West End) is a historically important Richmond Black congregation with roots stretching over 185 years. Rev. Dr. James Henry Harris is a serious scholar — Distinguished Professor of Homiletics at Virginia Union University and a published theologian. The problem: Rev. Harris is an academic whose theological framework is aligned with Black liberation theology, a school of thought that subordinates Scripture to the experience of racial oppression and reinterprets the Gospel through social and political liberation categories. This is not a Reformed or evangelical framework — it places experience and culture above Scripture's authority. For men seeking a doctrinally sound, Great Commission-focused church, Second Baptist (West End) is not the right fit. The historical legacy is real and deserves respect; the current theological direction is not.

churches.assessment: Washington National Cathedral is an architectural masterpiece and a significant national landmark — but from a USMC Ministries theological alignment standpoint, it is firmly not recommended. The Episcopal Church (TEC) has abandoned biblical authority on human sexuality, ordains women as bishops and priests, performs same-sex marriages, and its leadership uses the pulpit for progressive political advocacy. Bishop Mariann Budde's nationally publicized January 2025 inaugural sermon was a political statement, not a Gospel proclamation. The Cathedral has hosted interfaith services including Islamic prayers. The beauty of the building and the grandeur of the liturgy should not be confused with theological fidelity. This is included in the directory for situational awareness — military and government personnel in DC will be invited to events here. Know what you're walking into.
